messages.content: Analyse this resume: Skills: Python, Django, SQL, Git. Education: B.Tech Computer Science. Experience: 2 years as a backend developer. Projects: E-commerce REST API. Job description: Backend developer requiring Python, Django, SQL, REST API and Docker.

Candidate profile: Backend developer with two years of experience and a B.Tech in Computer Science. Matching skills: Python, Django and SQL. Missing skills: REST API knowledge is not explicitly confirmed by the listed skills, and Docker is not listed. Relevant project: E-commerce REST API. Recommendation: Clearly describe REST API implementation and gain practical Docker experience.

Analyse this resume: Skills: Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Git. Education: BCA. Experience: Fresher. Projects: Student Management System. Job description: Java developer requiring Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Microservices and AWS.

Candidate profile: Entry-level Java developer with a BCA qualification. Matching skills: Java, Spring Boot and MySQL. Missing skills: Microservices and AWS. Relevant project: Student Management System. Recommendation: Build a project using Microservices and learn basic AWS deployment.
Analyse this resume: Skills: Excel, Power BI, Tableau. Education: B.Com. Experience: 1 year as a reporting assistant. Job description: Data analyst requiring Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI and Tableau.

Candidate profile: Reporting professional with one year of experience and a B.Com qualification. Matching skills: Excel, Power BI and Tableau. Missing skills: SQL and Python. Recommendation: Learn SQL and Python and demonstrate data analysis through practical projects.

Analyse this resume: Skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React. Education: B.Tech IT. Experience: Fresher. Projects: Personal portfolio website. Job description: Frontend developer requiring HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and TypeScript.

Candidate profile: Entry-level frontend developer with a B.Tech in Information Technology. Matching skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React. Missing skills: TypeScript. Relevant project: Personal portfolio website. Recommendation: Learn TypeScript and build a React application using TypeScript.

Analyse this resume: Skills: Python, C++, Data Structures. Education: B.Tech CSE. Experience: Fresher. Projects: Basic calculator. Job description: Machine learning engineer requiring Python, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn and Machine Learning.

Candidate profile: Entry-level computer science graduate with Python and C++ knowledge. Matching skills: Python. Missing skills: NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn and demonstrated Machine Learning experience. Relevant project: Basic calculator. Recommendation: Develop a machine learning project using Python, Pandas and Scikit-learn.
